strings.splash_desc: Find the nearest public toilet, based on official City Council data, plus nearby bars, fast food or shopping centres as a backup.
strings.privacy1: Your location is only used to centre the map — it's never sent or stored anywhere.
strings.privacy2: Your favourites are saved locally on your device.
strings.report_link: Report a problem to the City Council
strings.outside_text: There's no service in this area. You may not be in Madrid, or there's an issue with the database.
strings.empty_text: No results with these filters. Try removing one.
strings.about_desc: Official toilets and business census from the Ayuntamiento de Madrid (CC BY 4.0), and community toilets from OpenStreetMap (ODbL).
strings.set_datos_hint: To bring your settings to another phone or browser.
strings.footer: Made by Ivan with ❤️ and lots of AI
strings.err_denied: Permission denied. Enable it in your browser settings to see nearby services.
strings.err_locate: We couldn't get your location. Please try again.
strings.err_load: Couldn't load the data. Reload the page and try again.
strings.ar_steps: It's just a few steps away
strings.ar_cal: Move your phone in a figure-8 to calibrate the compass
strings.ar_lift: Lift your phone to see it
strings.ar_follow: Follow the icon or the arrow
strings.ar_cam_no: Your browser doesn't allow camera access for AR.
strings.ar_cam_err: Couldn't open the camera. Check your permissions.
strings.ar_perm: I need orientation permission for the compass.
strings.far_text: This app only shows toilets and services in Madrid
strings.urgency_alt: {min} min: possible emergency toilet (paid or with purchase)
strings.urgency_nodata: No data on nearby free toilets
strings.radar_empty: Nothing on radar (more than {min} min walk)
strings.radar_caption: Tap a dot to see details
